# CANDIDATE: BASELINE_CELL_GATE_CHECK

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** quality_gate  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

In kitchen extra-lanes studies, baseline cells (control configurations) may lack unconditional production gates present in live config (e.g., NOT_NEAR_NAMED proximity, time stops, catastrophe caps), causing confusion between test baselines and production-equivalent setups. This risks misattributing performance differences to strategy changes when they stem from missing foundational guards.

## Mechanism

Augment the harness validation layer to scan all kitchen extra-lanes study configurations for baseline cells. For each baseline cell, verify inclusion of unconditional production gates defined in `automation/state/params.json` under `production_gates` (e.g., `chart_stop_enabled`, `premium_stop_pct`, `time_stop_et`, `not_near_named_proximity`). If any gate is missing, flag the cell for automatic renaming by appending `_baseline_no_gate` to its identifier, ensuring clear visual distinction from production-equivalent baselines. Integrate this check into the study harness pre-run validation.
